# Tests that fail on main today. The factory gate runs them with a strict
# xfail marker (see .github/scripts/factory_gate_pytest.py): a listed test
# that fails is reported but does not turn the gate red, and a listed test that
# passes turns it red until its line is removed here.
#
# Only Onur adds lines. The test-removal check fails any change that adds one.
#
# Format: <pytest node id> | <cause>
